title: The Telangana Metropolitan Planning Committee Act, 2007.
full_text: The Telangana Metropolitan Planning Committee Act, 2007. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200732 Act Number: 32 Enactment Date: 2007-12-06 Act Year: 2007 Short Title: The Telangana Metropolitan Planning Committee Act, 2007. Long Title: An Act to provide for the Constitution of Metropolitan Planning Committee in every Metropolitan Area in the State of Telangana for preparation of draft development plan for the Metropolitan Area as a whole and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
